statement: (Reduction.hM XM YM * XM 1 - XM 1 * Reduction.hM XM YM = (2 : ℤ) • XM 1) ∧ (Reduction.hM XM YM * YM 1 - YM 1 * Reduction.hM XM YM = (-2 : ℤ) • YM 1) ∧ (XM 1 * YM 1 - YM 1 * XM 1 = Reduction.hM XM YM)
proof:
rcases h_T006.1 with ⟨_, _, hx, hy, hh⟩
refine ⟨?_, ?_, rfl⟩
· ext m
  have he := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℂ V => f (m : V)) h_H005.1
  simpa [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    hh, hx, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ] using he
· ext m
  have he := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℂ V => f (m : V)) h_H005.2.1
  simpa [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    hh, hy, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ] using he
